purpose: Per-question lane subset for eval fast mode (workflow input eval_fast_mode=true). Evaluation only; production research still runs all eleven lanes.
method: Lanes chosen from the repositories each lane searches (tools/lane_repository_plan.py) and the gold sources listed for each item in the eval set. No new sources are introduced; the rationale only names source keys already in the eval set.
limits: A gold source can be missed if it is only reachable from an excluded lane; fast-mode scores are a lower bound on full-run recall.
Lane choice is not a historical claim; it is a search-routing choice.

ID-01-lantzas-aliases.rationale: Gold source FLORISTAN2005 (scholarly article, findable via the greek lane's OpenAlex/Crossref/Academia) cites AGS documents (spanish_simancas: PARES) and Venetian dispatches (venetian: ASVe).

ID-02-lanza-namesakes.rationale: Gold sources FLORISTAN2005 and GURKAN2014 are scholarly articles (greek lane scholarly connectors); Gürkan cites ASV Capi del Consiglio dei Dieci (venetian) and the Habsburg context points to Simancas (spanish_simancas).

ID-03-kapsis-aliases.rationale: Gold sources SAULGER1698 and TOURNEFORT1718: travellers lane searches BSB (Saulger 1698, bsb10447069) and Internet Archive (Tournefort 1718); french lane searches Gallica/BnF and French diplomatic archives (Saulger is a French print); Greek name forms (Καψής/Κάψης) via the greek lane searches SearchCulture/EKT, Anemi, OpenAlex, Crossref, Academia (Greek and scholarly literature).

ID-04-creveliers-aliases.rationale: Gold sources SAULGER1698, TOURNEFORT1718 (travellers lane searches BSB (Saulger 1698, bsb10447069) and Internet Archive (Tournefort 1718)), French corsair (french lane searches Gallica/BnF and French diplomatic archives (Saulger is a French print)), KOUTZAKIOTIS2023 is a Greek scholarly article (hdl 10442, greek lane).

FC-01-capsi-hanged-1680.rationale: Gold sources SAULGER1698 and TOURNEFORT1718: travellers lane searches BSB (Saulger 1698, bsb10447069) and Internet Archive (Tournefort 1718); french lane searches Gallica/BnF and French diplomatic archives (Saulger is a French print).

FC-02-creveliers-petra-1676.rationale: Gold source SAULGER1698: travellers lane searches BSB (Saulger 1698, bsb10447069) and Internet Archive (Tournefort 1718); french lane searches Gallica/BnF and French diplomatic archives (Saulger is a French print).

FC-03-lantzas-1596-arrest.rationale: Gold source FLORISTAN2005 (scholarly, greek lane connectors) cites AGS documents (spanish_simancas); the arrest was in Naples, whose state archives are in the italian_states lane (SIAS).

CT-01-creveliers-death-date.rationale: Contradiction between SAULGER1698 (travellers lane searches BSB (Saulger 1698, bsb10447069) and Internet Archive (Tournefort 1718); french lane searches Gallica/BnF and French diplomatic archives (Saulger is a French print)) and KOUTZAKIOTIS2023 (Greek scholarly article, greek lane).

CT-02-kapsis-origin.rationale: SAULGER1698 and TOURNEFORT1718 (travellers lane searches BSB (Saulger 1698, bsb10447069) and Internet Archive (Tournefort 1718); french lane searches Gallica/BnF and French diplomatic archives (Saulger is a French print)) versus STOUKAS2018, a Greek web article citing Krantonelli (greek lane).

CT-03-kapsis-dates.rationale: Gold source SAULGER1698 only (after historian review): travellers lane searches BSB (Saulger 1698, bsb10447069) and Internet Archive (Tournefort 1718); french lane searches Gallica/BnF and French diplomatic archives (Saulger is a French print).

NG-01-lantzas-milos-premise.rationale: False premise: Lantzas sources FLORISTAN2005/GURKAN2014 (greek scholarly connectors, spanish_simancas for AGS) versus SAULGER1698 for who actually ruled Milos (travellers: BSB).

NG-02-kapsis-morosini-battle.rationale: No gold source (false-premise item). Kapsis is documented in SAULGER1698/TOURNEFORT1718 (travellers, french); Morosini is Venetian, so the venetian lane is the place a real battle record would surface.

NG-03-fictional-zerphalon.rationale: Fictional control with no gold source; two broad lanes (travellers, greek) are enough to test that NABOU reports no evidence.

SY-01-milos-1660-1680.rationale: Gold sources SAULGER1698, TOURNEFORT1718 (travellers lane searches BSB (Saulger 1698, bsb10447069) and Internet Archive (Tournefort 1718); french lane searches Gallica/BnF and French diplomatic archives (Saulger is a French print)) and KOUTZAKIOTIS2023 (greek lane).

SY-02-kapsis-kingdom.rationale: Gold sources SAULGER1698 (travellers lane searches BSB (Saulger 1698, bsb10447069) and Internet Archive (Tournefort 1718); french lane searches Gallica/BnF and French diplomatic archives (Saulger is a French print)) and STOUKAS2018 (Greek web article, greek lane).

PN-01-argentiere.rationale: Gold source TOURNEFORT1718 (Argentiere chapter, Internet Archive, travellers lane); the modern name Κίμωλος via the greek lane.

PN-02-antimilo.rationale: Gold source TOURNEFORT1718 (Internet Archive, travellers lane); modern Greek name Αντίμηλος via the greek lane.

PN-03-cerigo.rationale: Gold source OSBORNE_COLL_V2 (Internet Archive, travellers lane); the question asks who held Cerigo, a Venetian possession (venetian lane); modern name Κύθηρα via the greek lane.

PN-04-gadronise-agathonisi.rationale: Gold source AURA14_PANTZOURIS (nepub.lib.uoa.gr, Greek scholarly publication, greek lane); travellers lane for the old toponym in travel literature.

FC-04-pirate-season-milos.rationale: Gold source AURA14_PANTZOURIS (Greek scholarly publication, greek lane); Roberts is an English captivity narrative, so the travellers lane (Internet Archive, Google Books).

FC-05-capuchins-milo.rationale: Gold sources SAULGER1698, TOURNEFORT1718: travellers lane searches BSB (Saulger 1698, bsb10447069) and Internet Archive (Tournefort 1718); Capuchin mission and Saulger are French (french lane searches Gallica/BnF and French diplomatic archives (Saulger is a French print)).

FC-06-siphanto-provencal-corsair.rationale: Gold source TOURNEFORT1718 (Internet Archive, travellers lane); Provençal corsair, French context (french lane searches Gallica/BnF and French diplomatic archives (Saulger is a French print)).

NG-04-manetas-phournoi-base.rationale: Gold source AURA14_KOUTSOUFLAKIS (nepub.lib.uoa.gr, greek lane); travellers lane as second broad lane for the negative check.

CT-04-manetas-legend-place.rationale: Gold source AURA14_KOUTSOUFLAKIS (nepub.lib.uoa.gr, greek lane); travellers lane as second broad lane.
